name: Test Meshery Integration
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Sistent
        run: npm run build

      - name: Package Sistent as tarball
        run: |
          npm pack
          TARBALL=$(ls *.tgz | head -n1)
          echo "TARBALL=$TARBALL" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Verify tarball exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "$TARBALL" ]; then
            echo "Error: Tarball not found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Checkout Meshery UI
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: meshery/meshery
          path: meshery-ui

      - name: Install Sistent in Meshery UI
        run: |
          cd meshery-ui
          npm install ../$TARBALL

      - name: Install Meshery UI dependencies
        run: |
          cd meshery-ui
          npm ci

      - name: Check for test script
        id: check_test_script
        run: |
          cd meshery-ui
          if grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json; then
            echo "has_test_script=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_test_script=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run Meshery UI tests
        if: steps.check_test_script.outputs.has_test_script == 'true'
        run: |
          cd meshery-ui
          npm test
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Build Meshery UI
        run: |
          cd meshery-ui
          npm run build
